show.description: A brave little girl named Sia dreams of becoming a great warrior and finding her lost grandfather. When a princess arrives with a dangerous royal mission promising gold and power, Sia boldly accepts the challenge. But a ruthless demon gang threatens anyone who takes the task. Will Sia and her team survive the deadly journey and complete the mission?
